## Où j'en suis
At the end of the last session the Q1 2027 tiered pricing is modelled on October net settled volume with the agreed exceptions, and the customer notice exists in a standard version and a Loomly/Pinecrest variant, but nothing has been sent: sending waits on Gil's review Friday 20 Nov 10:00 with Rachel, and the 30-day clause means the notice must land by 1 Dec (source: ses-px-3, p3-10, src-slack-gil)

- [en-cours] Impact and exceptions rerun with Loomly and Pinecrest kept on 0.50% + $0.25 until 31 March 2027 and Tradewell excluded: annualized uplift +$351k, 5 customers above +10% from Jan 1 (source: p3-02, ses-px-3)
- [en-cours] Notice draft in notice/q1-pricing-notice.md, standard and Loomly/Pinecrest variants, covering only the tiered rate and the unchanged $0.25 fee (source: p3-04, p3-06)
- [prochaine-étape] Gil's review Friday 20 Nov 10:00 with Rachel, then the mass email from Salesforce to the 38 billing contacts, before 1 Dec (source: p3-09, p3-10, src-slack-gil)
- [prochaine-étape] Rachel calls Loomly before the notice lands (source: p3-01, p3-08)
- [essai-raté] The Salesforce October volume export had no numbers for 5 of 38 customers (KeyError on Pinecrest Rentals) after the October field rename; replaced by the dashboard billing CSV for everyone (source: p2-02, p2-03)
- [question] Whether the +1% instant payout surcharge can apply to existing contracts under the MSA; Hartley & Moss answer Monday, so nothing about instant payouts goes out before then (source: p3-05, p2-05)
- [question] Loomly's CFO writes that Loomly stays on the current rate for the whole of 2027, while the agreed exception ends 31 March 2027 (source: src-mail-loomly, p3-01)
- [décision] Tiers at 0.55% under $5M monthly payout volume, 0.45% from $5M to $25M, 0.35% above, $0.25 per payout unchanged (source: p2-03)
- [décision] Loomly and Pinecrest keep the old rate until 31 March 2027 with new tiers from 1 April, Tradewell excluded under its contract, everyone else on new tiers from 1 Jan (source: p3-01)
